name: a109-open-loop
$comment: Four A109s (Heffley & Mnich, NASA CR-177476, Appendix D), open loop: the hover trim released, a collective step and a longitudinal cyclic pulse in hover, and a pedal pulse at 100 kt. Generated by design/build_model.py; see the README.

annotations.text: **Airframe.** RigidBody3D on its principal axes (the report's Ixz tilts them 10.49 deg from the body x axis). Each component is a modulated wrench source at its own point: ExternalWrenchSpatial bonded through a FixedTransform3DNeutral that carries the offset, so the bond graph forms r x F.

**Components** (modulated sources): the report's main rotor (flapping, thrust/inflow), fuselage, tail rotor, tailplane and fin, in SI. Their forces act at the hub, the fuselage point, the tail-rotor hub, the tailplane and the fin.

**Drivetrain** (rotational bond graph, ours): the rotor inertia on its 1-junction with the aerodynamic torque; the mast 0-junction (common torque) whose flows make rotor speed = gearbox speed + airframe yaw rate (ShaftAxis, the reaction torque on the airframe); the gearbox 1-junction with the engine torque (Governor), the transmission losses and the tail-rotor gear (TF) to the tail-rotor junction and its torque.

parameters.name: rpm_mode
parameters.description: Rotor speed the aerodynamics see: 1 the drivetrain's (bond graph), 0 the nominal 385 rpm (the report's constant-RPM model)

options.text: Four A109s released from trim. **Hover** stays put; **Coll** (+0.5 deg collective) climbs and yaws right as the main-rotor torque grows; **Lon** (a cyclic pulse) starts the unstable hover phugoid; **Fwd** (a pedal pulse at 100 kt) shows the Dutch roll. Switch the rotor speed the aerodynamics see between the drivetrain's and the report's constant 385 rpm.
